notes:
{傑出|けっしゅつ} describes someone or something remarkably superior to others, used to praise exceptional ability or achievement.

WRITING:
- {傑|けつ} (outstanding person, hero)
- {出|しゅつ} (come out, emerge)

USAGE:
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be outstanding - suru verb)
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧〜 (outstanding ~, distinguished ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧ (distinguished person)
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧ (outstanding talent)
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧ (distinguished achievements)
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (outstanding work)

REGISTER:
- Formal/written style
- Common in biographical descriptions, awards, and academic contexts
- High praise, often for historical figures or exceptional individuals
